registered.universe: crypto perps hourly + survivorship-clean ETFs daily
registered.entry: the retest close, NOT the break close
registered.exit: no target; hold 40 bars then exit at the close; stop only (doc 44)

exit_evidence.note: hold80 is partly drift (control +0.189R); hold40 control is +0.008R

registered.narrowed_before_registration: crypto hourly horizontals excluded: retest -0.115R beats the break -0.197R but still loses money
registered.forward_only: a setup is recorded only if its retest completes within the last 60 bars; the first build logged 12,271 historical setups
registered.minimum_evidence: 120 resolved trades or 6 months, whichever first
registered.pass: retest mean > 0 net of costs AND retest beats the PAIRED break entry
registered.fail: retest mean <= 0 at n=120, or paired break >= retest
not_evidence: the no-retest group, which is circular
registered.amendment: any spec change voids the run and restarts the clock

backtest_reference.mechanism: reward:risk, not hit rate — the stop sits under the level
backtest_reference.caveat: measured-move targets are over-ambitious (hit rates 13-24%); the retest edge holds because both arms share the target

archive_note: Pre-restart holdout, archived 2026-10-18 from the project copy. Counts for nothing. Trades are complete (every field); 'seen' was regenerated from the trades, so any dedup key that had no trade behind it is not reproduced.
